cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
p='submission/te/worker_solver.py'
s=open(p).read()
old="""            if gi is not None:
                lam = float(mu[gi]) if gi < len(mu) else 0.0
            if lam is None:
                lam = 0.0
            # Clamp tiny negative multipliers caused by roundoff.  A genuinely
            # positive lower bound is harmless for the certificate only when
            # the demand mass is tight; use the weighted formula there.
            R = 0.0
            num = 0.0
            for p in available[k]:
                val = float(flows[out_i][p])
                R += val
                num += val * float(gradients[out_i][p])
            if R > dk - 1.0e-9 * (1.0 + dk):
                wlam = -num / dk
                if wlam >= 0.0:
                    lam = wlam
            if lam < 0.0 and lam > -1.0e-8:
                lam = 0.0
            if lam < 0.0:
                # This should not occur; prefer the nonnegative weighted value.
                wlam = -num / dk if dk else 0.0
                lam = max(0.0, wlam)
"""
new="""            R = 0.0
            num = 0.0
            for p in available[k]:
                val = float(flows[out_i][p])
                R += val
                num += val * float(gradients[out_i][p])
            # A commodity whose admission constraint has positive slack has
            # multiplier exactly zero.  This exact zero matters: an innocuous
            # 1e-11 multiplier would be multiplied by a demand of 1000 in D.
            if R < dk - 1.0e-9 * (1.0 + dk):
                lam = 0.0
            else:
                # The demand bound is tight (or numerically tight): use the
                # weighted-gradient multiplier, which also makes f=D exact.
                wlam = -num / dk
                if wlam >= 0.0:
                    lam = wlam
                elif gi is not None:
                    lam = float(mu[gi]) if gi < len(mu) else 0.0
                else:
                    lam = 0.0
                if lam < 0.0 and lam > -1e-8:
                    lam = 0.0
                if lam < 0.0:
                    lam = max(0.0, wlam)
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
